name: SpanishModelVariant441_HandleRequest
evidence: matching spanish_model_variant/variant441_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the configuration record at data + 0xFC indexed by the request and packs the textures, otherwise it runs one frame and calls the rainbow-sheet, ring, tubular-mesh and framebuffer-ring helpers behind their start-frame and phase gates; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md, notes/overlays/spanish-model-variant441-entry.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US and Japanese header-424 images build the same source through model_variant/variant424_entry.c, which selects CLUT x 512, and bind the helpers and the data (0x20 higher) at their own addresses. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
